itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival @ Kochi – Transfer to Munnar
itinerary.details:
On arrival at Kochi Airport/Railway Station, our representative will receive you and transfer you to Munnar (approx. 4–5 hours drive). On the way, enjoy the scenic beauty of Kerala's lush landscapes with cheerful streams, small waterfalls, tea plantations, and spice gardens.

En-route, visit:
- Cheeyappara & Valara Waterfalls – cascading falls amidst thick forests.
- Tea Plantations Viewpoints – capture breathtaking photos.

On reaching Munnar, check-in at the hotel. Rest of the day is at leisure. In the evening, take a stroll at Munnar town local market or enjoy the serene atmosphere. Overnight stay at Munnar.

After breakfast, proceed for a full-day sightseeing tour of Munnar. Explore the famous attractions:

- Eravikulam National Park (Rajamalai) – home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr, rolling hills, and tea estates.
- Mattupetty Dam & Lake – famous for its storage masonry dam, speed boating, and lush surroundings.
- Echo Point – a scenic place where your voice echoes back.
- Kundala Lake – known for pedal boating and serene landscapes.
- Tea Museum (TATA Tea Museum) – learn about the history and process of tea-making.

In the evening, return to the hotel and relax. Dinner & overnight stay at Munnar.

After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive back to Kochi. Depending on your departure time, enjoy sightseeing in Kochi 

  Fort Kochi & St. Francis Church – one of the oldest European churches in India. 
  Chinese Fishing Nets – iconic view along the Fort Kochi beachside.
 Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace) – famous for Kerala murals and history.
 Jew Town & Synagogue – explore antique shops and heritage streets.
  Later transfer to Kochi Airport/Railway Station for onward journey. Tour ends.

packages.name: 2 Nights Munnar + 1 Night Alleppey
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival in Kochi, sightseeing and local cuisine.
Day 2: Munnar tea gardens and Mattupetty Dam.
Day 3: Thekkady wildlife sanctuary and spice plantations.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival Bhubaneswar – Transfer to Puri
itinerary.details: Arrive Bhubaneswar, drive to Puri (approx. 1.5–2 hours). Visit Puri Beach, Jagannath Temple (view from outside for non-pilgrims), and local market. Evening leisure at beach. Overnight at Puri.
After breakfast drive to Konark (approx. 1 hour) to visit the Sun Temple (UNESCO), then proceed to Chilika Lake (Satapada) for possible dolphin-spotting boat cruise. Return to Puri. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, check-out and drive to Bhubaneswar. Quick city tour: Lingaraj Temple (view), Udayagiri & Khandagiri caves. Transfer to station/airport for onward journey.
Arrival in Bhubaneswar. Visit Lingaraj Temple, Mukteshwar Temple, and Khandagiri & Udayagiri caves. Overnight at Bhubaneswar.
Drive to Konark (Sun Temple) and then to Puri. Evening at Puri Beach. Overnight at Puri.
Full-day Chilika Lake trip with boat ride to see Irrawaddy dolphins and birdlife. Return to Puri for overnight stay.
Morning at leisure, shop at Puri market, then transfer to Bhubaneswar for departure.
Arrival @ Chandigarh On arrival at Chandigarh airport, we will transfer you to Chandigarh hotel. Visit Rock Garden, Rose Garden, Panchakula Lake, Sukhana Lake etc.

itinerary.day: Day 02: Mandi sightseeing + Travel to Manali
itinerary.details:
In the morning, check out from hotel and visit to Prashar Lake, Barot Valley, Panchvaktra Temple, Dehnasar Lake, Shikhari Devi Temple etc. Later drive to Manali (Approximately 4 hours ).
 After completing sightseeing in Mandi, we will drive to Manali. Enjoy the beautiful views of Beas river and Kullu valley. Upon reaching, check-in at the hotel and take some rest. In the evening, you can either explore its numerous places of interest or take a stroll on the popular Mall Road.
 This street is dotted with numerous eateries, cafes, local handicraft shops and retail brand outlets where tourists can not only go on a shopping spree, but can also relish mouth-watering local dishes. Later, return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.

In the morning after breakfast, we will start the sightseeing. We will go to Lahaul via Atal Tunnel.
 Enjoy the beautiful Sissu valley, Baralacha Pass, Chandra Taal etc. enjoy skiing. Later back to Manali hotel for overnight stay.

In the morning after breakfast, we will start the sightseeing. We will go to Lahaul via Atal Tunnel. 
 A land of wide contrasts on the Manali-Leh route, Lahaul is a bouquet of scenic mountain villages and fascinating Buddhist art and culture. As the better half of Spiti that lies across the high Kunzum Pass, Lahaul is marked by high mountains, massive glaciers, rivers and high passes. On the way also enjoy the beautiful journey through Atal tunnel.
 Enjoy the beautiful Sissu valley, Baralacha Pass, Chandra Taal etc. enjoy skiing. Later back to Manali hotel for overnight stay.

In the morning, check out from hotel and drive to Kasol . It serves as the gateway to some of Himachal Pradesh's most scenic treks, including the famous Kheerganga trek, where pathways lined with lush foliage lead to sulphur hot springs—a perfect reward after a vigorous hike. For the more seasoned adventurers, the challenges of the Pin Parvati Pass await. On arrival at Kasol, visit to Manikaran Hot Spring. 
 Believed to have healing and curative properties, the Manikaran Hot Springs alongside the Gurudwara Shri Manikaran Sahib is visited by many pilgrims who come to bathe here.
 Later back to hotel for overnight stay. 
 Later drive to Delhi Airport for homeward journey. Tour End.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Manali & Local Sightseeing
itinerary.details:
On arrival at Manali (Airport/Bus stand), check-in at the hotel. After freshening up, start exploring local attractions of Manali:
 Hadimba Devi Temple – ancient wooden temple dedicated to Goddess Hidimba, surrounded by cedar forests.
 Manu Temple – dedicated to Sage Manu, believed to be the creator of the world according to Hindu mythology.
 Vashisht Village & Hot Springs – famous for natural hot water springs with medicinal properties.
  Nehru Kund – a natural spring named after Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru 
 Club House – enjoy indoor & outdoor activities like billiards, skating, and boating.Later, return to the hotel for dinner & overnight stay.

itinerary.day: Day 02: Solang Valley / Atal Tunnel Excursion
itinerary.details:
After breakfast, proceed for a full-day excursion to Solang Valley and Atal Tunnel (Lahaul side):
  Solang Valley – famous for adventure sports like paragliding, zorbing, ropeway, horse riding, and skiing (in winters). 
 Atal Tunnel – drive through one of the longest high-altitude tunnels in the world and visit Sissu Village & waterfalls on the Lahaul side.
 Enjoy breathtaking views of snow-capped mountains, glaciers, and valleys 
 
 Return to Manali in the evening. Overnight stay at hotel.

After breakfast, check out from hotel. Visit:
  Naggar Castle – a heritage structure offering stunning views of the Kullu Valley. 
 
 Roerich Art Gallery – displays paintings of Russian artist Nicholas Roerich.
 Jagatsukh Temple – an ancient Shiva temple with scenic surroundings.
Arrive at Ranchi. Visit Jagannath Temple, Ranchi Lake, then drive to Jonha Falls/Gandhi Nagar for scenic views. Overnight at Ranchi.
Full-day excursion to Hundru Falls and Dassam Falls. Picnic and nature walk. Return to Ranchi for overnight.
Morning local market visit, Rock Garden (if time). Transfer to station/airport for onward journey.
Arrive Ranchi; visit local city spots and evening at Ranchi Hill viewpoints. Overnight stay.
Drive to Netarhat (approx. 4–5 hours). Sunset at Netarhat Sun Viewpoint. Overnight at Netarhat.
Explore Magnolia Point, Upper Ghaghri Falls, and local forest trails. Overnight at Netarhat.
Drive back to Ranchi and transfer to onward journey.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Guwahati – Transfer to Kaziranga
itinerary.details: Arrive at Guwahati Airport and drive to Kaziranga (approx. 5 hrs). Check-in and enjoy the lush greenery. Evening free. Overnight stay at Kaziranga.
Early morning elephant safari and later a jeep safari in the Central Range. Evening cultural show or local village visit. Overnight stay at Kaziranga.
Drive back to Guwahati. Visit Kamakhya Temple, Brahmaputra river cruise. Overnight stay at Guwahati.
After breakfast, transfer to Guwahati Airport/Railway Station. Tour ends.
Arrive at Jorhat, visit local tea estates and Tocklai Tea Research Centre. Overnight at Jorhat.
Drive to Neemati Ghat and cross over to Majuli Island by ferry. Visit Satras (Vaishnavite monasteries) and enjoy Assamese culture. Overnight stay at Majuli.
Explore pottery villages, mask-making artisans, and interact with locals. Overnight stay at Majuli.
Return to Jorhat, visit Sivasagar Ahom monuments and temples. Overnight at Jorhat.
Transfer to Jorhat Airport for onward journey.
Meet our representative and transfer to hotel. Visit Kamakhya Temple and local markets. Overnight stay in Guwahati.
After breakfast, drive to Sualkuchi (Silk Village) and Hajo – known for Hindu, Muslim & Buddhist shrines. Return and stay overnight in Guwahati.
After breakfast, visit Umananda Temple (Peacock Island) and transfer to airport/railway station.
Arrive Patna. Visit Golghar, Patna Sahib Gurudwara, and Patna Museum. Evening at Gandhi Maidan. Overnight at Patna.
Drive to Nalanda (approx. 2 hours) to visit the Nalanda University ruins and Nalanda Archaeological Museum. Proceed to Rajgir to see hot springs and Vishwa Shanti Stupa. Overnight near Rajgir.
Early drive to Bodh Gaya to visit Mahabodhi Temple complex. Return to Patna for onward travel.
Arrive Patna. Light city tour and overnight.
Explore Nalanda ruins, archaeological museum and then Rajgir attractions. Overnight at Rajgir.
Drive to Bodh Gaya; visit Mahabodhi Temple, Bodhi Tree, Tibetan monasteries. Overnight in Bodh Gaya.
Visit Vaishali (ancient Buddhist site and stupa); return to Patna area. Overnight.
Transfer to airport/railway for onward journey.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Guwahati – Transfer to Shillong
itinerary.details: Arrive at Guwahati Airport and transfer to Shillong (approx. 3–4 hrs). En route, stop at Umiam Lake for boating and scenic views. Evening free to explore Police Bazaar. Overnight stay at Shillong.
Drive to Cherrapunjee (54 km – 2 hrs). Visit Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai Cave, Eco Park, and Seven Sisters Falls. Return to Shillong by evening. Overnight stay at Shillong.
Full-day excursion to Asia's cleanest village – Mawlynnong, and Dawki for crystal-clear Umngot River boating. Return to Shillong. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer to Guwahati for departure. En route visit Don Bosco Museum if time permits.
Arrive at Guwahati and transfer to Shillong. Stop at Umiam Lake. Overnight stay at Shillong.
Explore Ward's Lake, Shillong Peak, Elephant Falls, and Cathedral of Mary. Overnight stay at Shillong.
Drive to Cherrapunjee; visit Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai Caves, and Dainthlen Falls. Stay overnight in Cherrapunjee.
Drive to Dawki for boating on Umngot River, then visit Mawlynnong Village. Overnight stay at Shillong.
After breakfast, drive to Guwahati for onward journey.
Reach Shillong and check in to your hotel. Visit Umiam Lake and local cafes. Overnight stay at Shillong.
Full-day visit to Mawsmai, Arwah, and Garden of Caves. Explore Dainthlen Falls. Overnight stay in Shillong.
After breakfast, transfer to Guwahati Airport/Railway Station.
Arrive at Shillong, visit Ward's Lake and Don Bosco Museum. Overnight stay.

itinerary.day: Day 02: Trek to Double Decker Living Root Bridge (Nongriat)
itinerary.details: Drive to Tyrna village and trek to the famous Double Decker Living Root Bridge. Return and stay overnight in Cherrapunjee.
Visit Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai Caves, and Eco Park. Return to Shillong. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer to Guwahati for onward journey.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Guwahati – Transfer to Bhalukpong
itinerary.details: Arrive at Guwahati Airport and transfer to Bhalukpong (approx. 6 hrs). En route enjoy views of the Brahmaputra valley. Check-in and overnight stay.
After breakfast, drive to Dirang (5 hrs). Visit Tipi Orchid Centre and Dirang Dzong. Overnight stay at Dirang.
Drive through scenic Sela Pass (13,700 ft) and visit Jaswant Garh War Memorial. Arrive at Tawang. Overnight stay.
Explore Tawang Monastery, Urgelling Monastery, Tawang War Memorial, and local markets. Overnight stay.
Drive back to Bomdila and continue towards Tezpur/Guwahati for onward journey.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Tezpur – Transfer to Dirang
itinerary.details: Meet at Tezpur and drive through lush valleys to Dirang. Visit local monasteries and Dirang Dzong. Overnight stay.
Drive up to Sela Pass (snow point in winter). Visit Jaswant Garh War Memorial. Return to Dirang. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, drive to Bomdila. Visit Bomdila Monastery and local markets. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer back to Tezpur/Guwahati.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Itanagar – Transfer to Ziro
itinerary.details: Arrive at Itanagar and drive to Ziro (approx. 6 hrs). Check-in and relax. Overnight stay.
Explore Apatani tribal villages, local markets, and Ziro Music Festival grounds. Overnight stay.
Drive back to Itanagar. Visit Ganga Lake and Ita Fort. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer to Guwahati Airport/Railway Station.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Guwahati – Transfer to Bomdila
itinerary.details: Arrive at Guwahati and drive to Bomdila (8 hrs). Visit Bomdila Monastery. Overnight stay.
Drive via Dirang, stop for sightseeing and lunch. Arrive at Tawang. Overnight stay.
Visit Tawang Monastery, War Memorial, and craft centers. Overnight stay.
Return to Dirang with scenic stops. Overnight stay.
Drive back to Tezpur and drop at airport/station.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Dimapur – Transfer to Kohima
itinerary.details: Arrive at Dimapur Airport and drive to Kohima (approx. 3 hrs). Check-in at hotel and relax. Evening free to explore local market. Overnight stay.
Visit Kohima War Cemetery, State Museum, and local Naga heritage villages. Evening leisure. Overnight stay at Kohima.
Enjoy full-day at Kisama Heritage Village for Hornbill Festival — dance, tribal music, and handicrafts. Overnight stay at Kohima.
Excursion to Khonoma (first green village of India). Learn about Angami tribe traditions. Return to Kohima for overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer back to Dimapur Airport for onward journey.
Meet at Dimapur Airport and transfer to hotel. Visit Triple Falls and Kachari Ruins. Overnight stay.
Drive to Touphema Heritage Village, showcasing Naga culture and cuisine. Enjoy traditional dance performance. Overnight stay.
Visit Kohima War Cemetery, State Museum, and local markets. Return to Touphema. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Dimapur Airport for onward journey.
Arrive at Dimapur and drive to Wokha (approx. 5 hrs). Explore Lotha tribal villages. Overnight stay.
Drive to Mokokchung (4 hrs). Visit Longkhum and Ungma villages – centers of Ao culture. Overnight stay.
Visit District Museum, local markets, and meet local artisans. Overnight stay.
Drive to Kohima with en-route scenic halts. Evening leisure. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer to Dimapur for onward journey.
Arrive at Dimapur and transfer to Kohima. Visit War Cemetery and State Museum. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, visit Khonoma Village – known for its sustainable lifestyle and Naga traditions. Return to Kohima. Overnight stay.
Drive back to Dimapur for onward journey.
Arrive at Imphal Airport. Check in to the hotel and relax. Later visit Ima Keithel (women's market) and Kangla Fort. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, drive to Loktak Lake (48 km). Visit Sendra Island and Keibul Lamjao National Park (home of Sangai deer). Return to Imphal. Overnight stay.
Explore INA Memorial at Moirang and Vishnu Temple at Bishnupur. Enjoy local Manipuri dance performance in the evening. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer to Imphal Airport for onward journey.
Drive to Ukhrul (approx. 5 hrs). En route enjoy scenic views of Shirui Hills. Check in and rest.

itinerary.day: Day 02: Shirui Lily Trek & Khangkhui Caves
itinerary.details: Trek to Shirui Peak to see the rare Shirui Lily (seasonal). Later visit Khangkhui limestone caves. Overnight stay at Ukhrul.
Return to Imphal and visit Kangla Fort, Govindajee Temple, and local markets. Overnight stay.
Drive to Loktak Lake for boating among floating islands. Return to Imphal for overnight stay.
Transfer to Imphal Airport after breakfast. Tour ends.
Arrive and explore Kangla Fort, Manipur State Museum, and RKCS Art Gallery. Overnight stay.
Visit Andro Village – known for pottery and handicrafts. Meet local artisans and explore cultural museum. Overnight stay at Imphal.
Morning free time. Later, drop at Imphal Airport.
Arrival at Imphal. Evening free to explore local streets. Overnight stay.
Visit War Cemetery, Kangla Fort, and Ima Keithel. Overnight stay at Imphal.
Drive to Loktak Lake, visit Sendra Island and Keibul Lamjao National Park. Overnight at Imphal.
Half-day tour to Andro Village followed by a Manipuri dance show. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Imphal Airport for onward journey.
Arrive at Aizawl Airport and transfer to hotel. Visit Durtlang Hills for panoramic city views, Solomon's Temple, and local markets. Overnight stay at Aizawl.
Visit Mizoram State Museum, Reiek Heritage Village, and nearby villages to experience local Mizo culture. Evening free. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer to Aizawl Airport for onward journey.
Arrive and transfer to hotel. Evening free to explore Aizawl local markets. Overnight stay.
Drive to Serchhip, visit Vantawng Falls (tallest waterfall in Mizoram) and local villages. Overnight stay at Serchhip.
Morning drive to Tamdil Lake (boating and nature walks). Return to Aizawl. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Aizawl Airport for onward journey.
Arrive at Aizawl Airport, check in, visit Durtlang Hills and evening stroll at Bara Bazar. Overnight stay.
Explore Mizoram State Museum, Reiek Heritage Village, and Tuirial Dam viewpoint. Overnight stay.

itinerary.day: Day 03: Day Trip to Eco Village
itinerary.details: Visit nearby Eco Village to learn Mizo traditions, bamboo crafts, and farming practices. Return to Aizawl. Overnight stay.
Excursion to Serchhip for Vantawng Falls and nearby tribal villages. Return to Aizawl. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Aizawl Airport for onward journey.
Arrive and check in. Visit local markets and evening leisure. Overnight stay at Aizawl.
Visit Reiek Hills for trekking, panoramic views, and Mizo village experience. Overnight stay at Aizawl.
Morning drive to Tamdil Lake for boating and nature exploration. Return to Aizawl. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer to Aizawl Airport for onward journey.
Arrive at Agartala Airport/Railway Station. Check-in at hotel. Evening visit local markets and heritage spots. Overnight stay.
Drive to Neermahal Palace (Lake Palace). Enjoy boating and palace visit. Return to Agartala. Overnight stay.
After breakfast, visit Ujjayanta Palace and Tripura State Museum. Transfer to airport/station for onward journey.
Arrive at Agartala and check in. Evening free. Overnight stay at hotel.
Drive to Unakoti (approx. 3–4 hrs). Explore ancient rock carvings and sculptures. Return to Agartala. Overnight stay.
Visit Neermahal Palace and Sepahijala Wildlife Sanctuary. Overnight stay in Agartala.
Transfer to Agartala Airport/Railway Station after breakfast.
Arrive at Agartala, check-in, visit Ujjayanta Palace and local markets. Overnight stay.

itinerary.day: Day 02: Rural Trip to Local Villages
itinerary.details: Visit nearby villages, experience local crafts, and taste authentic Tripura cuisine. Overnight stay at Agartala.
Transfer to airport/railway station for onward journey.
Check in to hotel. Evening visit local bazaars and markets. Overnight stay.
Drive to Neermahal Palace, enjoy lake-side views and palace tour. Return to Agartala. Overnight stay.
Morning visit to Sepahijala Wildlife Sanctuary. Afternoon visit rural villages and craft centers. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Agartala Airport/Railway Station after breakfast.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Bagdogra – Transfer to Gangtok
itinerary.details: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station and drive to Gangtok (approx. 4–5 hrs). Check-in at hotel. Evening free to explore MG Marg. Overnight stay.
Visit Rumtek Monastery, Enchey Monastery, Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, and Hanuman Tok viewpoint. Overnight stay at Gangtok.

itinerary.day: Day 03: Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir Excursion
itinerary.details: Drive to Tsomgo Lake (40 km, 2 hrs). Visit Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir and enjoy scenic views. Return to Gangtok. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station for onward journey.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Bagdogra – Transfer to Pelling
itinerary.details: Arrive and drive to Pelling (approx. 5–6 hrs). Evening free. Overnight stay at Pelling.
Visit Pemayangtse Monastery, Khecheopalri Lake, Rabdentse Ruins, and Singshore Bridge. Overnight stay at Pelling.
Drive to Rabangla. Visit Ralang Monastery and scenic viewpoints. Overnight stay at Rabangla.
Drive to Gangtok (approx. 4 hrs). Visit Do Drul Chorten and local markets. Overnight stay at Gangtok.
Transfer to Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station for onward journey.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Bagdogra – Transfer to Gangtok
itinerary.details: Arrive and drive to Gangtok. Evening free. Overnight stay.
Rumtek Monastery, Enchey Monastery, and MG Marg. Overnight stay at Gangtok.
Drive to Lachen (approx. 6–7 hrs). En route visit Singhik Viewpoint and Seven Sisters Waterfalls. Overnight stay at Lachen.
Early morning excursion to Gurudongmar Lake. Return to Gangtok by evening. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station for onward journey.
Arrive and transfer to Gangtok. Evening free. Overnight stay.
Visit Namchi to see the giant Buddha Statue, Char Dham, and Samdruptse Monastery. Return to Gangtok. Overnight stay.
Rumtek Monastery, Do Drul Chorten, and MG Marg shopping. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station for onward journey.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Bagdogra – Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.details: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station and drive to Darjeeling (approx. 3 hrs). Evening stroll at Chowrasta & Mall Road. Overnight stay at Darjeeling.

Early morning visit Tiger Hill for sunrise over Kanchenjunga, Batasia Loop, Ghoom Monastery, and Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (Toy Train). Afternoon visit Tea Gardens and local markets. Overnight stay.
Drive to Mirik Lake (Sumendu Lake), enjoy boating and scenic views. Return to Darjeeling for overnight stay.
After breakfast, transfer to Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station for onward journey.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Bagdogra – Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.details: Arrive and transfer to Darjeeling. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay.
Tiger Hill sunrise, Batasia Loop, Ghoom Monastery, and Himalayan Mountaineering Institute. Overnight stay at Darjeeling.
Drive to Kalimpong (approx. 2–3 hrs). Visit Zang Dhok Palri Phodang Monastery, Durpin Dara Hill, and local markets. Overnight stay at Kalimpong.
Drive to Gangtok (Sikkim border). En route visit scenic viewpoints. Evening leisure in Gangtok. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station for onward journey.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Bagdogra – Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.details: Arrive and drive to Darjeeling. Evening visit Chowrasta and Mall Road. Overnight stay.
Visit Happy Valley Tea Estate, explore local villages and markets. Afternoon Toy Train ride. Overnight stay at Darjeeling.
Transfer to Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station after breakfast.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival at Bagdogra – Transfer to Darjeeling
itinerary.details: Check-in at hotel. Evening leisure at Chowrasta & local markets. Overnight stay.
Tiger Hill, Batasia Loop, Ghoom Monastery, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute. Overnight stay.
Drive to Mirik for boating in Sumendu Lake and visit local orchards. Return to Darjeeling. Overnight stay.
Transfer to Bagdogra Airport/Railway Station after breakfast.
Arrive Khajuraho. Visit Western Group of Temples (UNESCO), sound-and-light show in evening (if available). Overnight at Khajuraho.
Drive to Orchha (approx. 3 hours). Explore Orchha Fort, Raja Mahal, Jahangir Mahal and riverside cenotaphs. Overnight at Orchha.
After breakfast depart to nearest rail/airport (Jhansi/Bhopal) for onward journey.
Arrive and transfer to Bandhavgarh area for wildlife stay. Evening at leisure.
Early morning and evening jeep safaris to try and spot tigers and other wildlife (park permits extra). Overnight near park.
Drive to Khajuraho. Evening at leisure. Overnight at Khajuraho.
Full day exploring Western & Eastern Group of Temples and local museum. Overnight.
Transfer to nearest rail/airport for onward journey.
Arrive Gurgaon (Gurugram). Evening leisure at Cyber Hub and local malls. Overnight at Gurgaon.
Visit Sultanpur National Park for birdwatching (seasonal). Afternoon visit to local cultural spots. Overnight at Gurgaon.
Morning free for shopping, then transfer to Delhi station/airport for onward journey.
Arrive Kurukshetra; visit Brahma Sarovar, Jyotisar and local temples. Overnight at Kurukshetra.
Drive to Panipat; visit Panipat Battlefields and Panipat Museum, local textile markets. Overnight at Panipat/nearby.
Explore local craft clusters and nearby heritage villages. Overnight.
Drive back to Delhi/Gurgaon for onward journey.
Arrive Amritsar. Visit Golden Temple (evening Aarti), Jallianwala Bagh and local markets for phulkari and handicrafts. Overnight at Amritsar.
Witness the Wagah Border ceremony in the evening. Daytime visit to Partition Museum or rural village visit (optional). Overnight at Amritsar.

itinerary.day: Day 03: Patiala Day Trip or Departure
itinerary.details: Optional day trip to Patiala to see Qila Mubarak and local bazaars; otherwise depart from Amritsar.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival Chandigarh – Rock Garden & Rose Garden
itinerary.details: Arrive Chandigarh; visit Rock Garden, Sukhna Lake, and Rose Garden. Overnight at Chandigarh.
Drive to Amritsar. Evening visit to Golden Temple for Aarti. Overnight at Amritsar.
Wagah Border ceremony in the evening and daytime sightseeing like Partition Museum, Jallianwala Bagh. Overnight at Amritsar.
Drive back to Chandigarh and transfer to onward transport.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Chennai Arrival – Marina & Fort St. George
itinerary.details: Arrive Chennai. Visit Marina Beach, Fort St. George and Kapaleeswarar Temple. Overnight in Chennai.
Drive to Mahabalipuram to see Shore Temple, Arjuna's Penance and rock-cut temples. Return to Chennai for overnight or stay in Mahabalipuram by choice.
Morning shopping for Tanjore paintings and handicrafts. Transfer to station/airport.
Arrive Madurai; visit Meenakshi Amman Temple, Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace. Overnight in Madurai.

itinerary.day: Day 02: Madurai – Thekkady/Drive to Ooty (via Coimbatore)
itinerary.details: Long scenic drive toward Ooty with optional stop at Thekkady or Coimbatore depending on route. Overnight en route or in Ooty.
Visit Botanical Gardens, Doddabetta Peak, Ooty Lake, and tea gardens. Overnight at Ooty.
Day trip to Coonoor (Sim's Park, Lamb's Rock) and return to Ooty. Overnight.
Transfer to nearest rail/airport (Coimbatore) for onward travel.
Arrive Bengaluru. Visit Lalbagh Botanical Garden, Cubbon Park, and MG Road/Brigade for evenings. Overnight in Bengaluru.
Drive to Coorg (approx. 5–6 hours). Visit Abbey Falls, Raja's Seat for sunset. Overnight in Coorg.
Explore coffee plantation tour in the morning. Drive back to Bengaluru or transfer to nearest airport for onward journey.
Arrive Bengaluru, city tour and overnight.
Travel to Hampi (overnight drive or rail). On arrival visit Virupaksha Temple and local ruins. Overnight at Hampi.
Explore Vittala Temple complex, Stone Chariot, Royal Enclosure, and Hemakuta Hill viewpoints. Overnight at Hampi.
Return to Bengaluru and transfer to your onward transport.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Arrival Vizag – Beaches & RK Beach
itinerary.details: Arrive Visakhapatnam. Visit RK Beach, Submarine Museum (INS Kurusura), and local promenades. Overnight at Vizag.
Morning visit Kailasagiri viewpoint, then day trip to Araku Valley (if time) or Borra Caves. Return to Vizag for overnight.
Shopping for local handicrafts, transfer to station/airport for onward travel.
Arrive Vizag; local sightseeing and evening at RK Beach. Overnight.
Full-day trip to Araku Valley and Borra Caves. Overnight at Vizag/Araku (based on hotel).
Drive to Tirupati (or take train/flight option). Evening at leisure in Tirupati. Overnight.
Tirupati darshan (timings & quota permitting) or visit Sri Venkateswara Temple complex and local sights. Transfer to departure point.

itinerary.day: Day 01: Hyderabad Arrival – Charminar & Local Bazaars
itinerary.details: Arrive Hyderabad. Visit Charminar, Laad Bazaar, and nearby Mecca Masjid. Evening tasting of Hyderabadi cuisine (biryani). Overnight in Hyderabad.

itinerary.day: Day 02: Golconda Fort & Qutb Shahi Tombs
itinerary.details: Visit Golconda Fort with light-and-sound (if available), Qutb Shahi Tombs, and Salar Jung Museum. Evening at Hussain Sagar Lake (Necklace Road). Overnight.
Morning for shopping or Ramoji Film City optional (extra). Transfer to airport/railway for onward journey.
Arrive Hyderabad. City tour including Charminar & Salar Jung Museum. Overnight Hyderabad.
Drive to Warangal (approx. 3 hours). Visit Warangal Fort, Thousand Pillar Temple, and local bazaars. Overnight at Warangal.
Visit Pakhal Lake and nearby scenic spots, local temples. Return to Warangal for overnight.
Drive back to Hyderabad and transfer to station/airport.

On arrival at Jaipur airport/railway station, transfer to the hotel. After freshening up, visit City Palace, Jantar Mantar, and the magnificent Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds). In the evening, enjoy shopping at the local bazaars. Overnight stay at Jaipur.
After breakfast, proceed to visit Amber Fort and enjoy an elephant ride/jeep ride to the fort. Later, visit Jaigarh Fort, Nahargarh Fort, and Jal Mahal. Evening at leisure. Overnight stay at Jaipur.

Check out after breakfast and drive towards Udaipur, the 'City of Lakes'. En route, visit Chittorgarh Fort – the largest fort in India and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. On arrival at Udaipur, check in to the hotel. Evening leisure by Lake Pichola. Overnight stay at Udaipur.

After breakfast, enjoy full-day sightseeing in Udaipur. Visit the City Palace (one of the largest palace complexes in Rajasthan), Saheliyon Ki Bari, Jagdish Temple, and Fateh Sagar Lake. In the evening, enjoy a boat ride at Lake Pichola and visit Jag Mandir. Overnight stay at Udaipur.
After breakfast, check out from hotel. Depending on your flight/train schedule, visit Shilpgram or local markets. Later, transfer to Udaipur airport/railway station for onward journey. Tour Ends.

packages.name: Royal Jaipur Weekend
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival Jaipur, City Palace & Hawa Mahal.

itinerary.details: Arrive at Jodhpur airport/railway station. Visit Mehrangarh Fort and Jaswant Thada. Evening leisure at local markets near Clock Tower. Overnight stay in Jodhpur.
After breakfast, visit Umaid Bhawan Palace, Mandore Gardens, and stepwells (Toorji ka Jhalra). Evening free for shopping and local cuisine. Overnight stay in Jodhpur.
Morning at leisure. Optional Bishnoi Village Safari (if time permits). Drop at Jodhpur airport/railway station. Tour ends.

Early morning pick up from Delhi and proceed towards Nainital, a beautiful hill station in Uttarakhand surrounded by lush green hills. On arrival, check into the hotel. Evening free for leisure – take a walk around Mall Road, explore the Tibetan Market, or enjoy boating at Naini Lake under the stars. Overnight stay at Nainital.

After breakfast, enjoy full-day sightseeing of Nainital. Visit Naina Devi Temple, Snow View Point (via ropeway), Tiffin Top, and Raj Bhawan. Spend time at the scenic Naini Lake – boating, yachting, or just relaxing by the lakeside. Evening for shopping at Mall Road. Overnight stay in Nainital.

After breakfast, drive towards Jim Corbett National Park, India's oldest and most famous tiger reserve. En route, you may stop at Corbett Museum or Corbett Falls. On arrival, check into the wildlife resort. Evening free for leisure or nature walk by the Kosi River. Dinner and overnight stay at resort.

Early morning Jeep Safari inside Corbett National Park to spot tigers, elephants, deer, and a variety of birds. Return to resort for breakfast. Day free for leisure – you can enjoy resort activities like swimming, indoor games, or relax amidst nature. Optional evening safari (at extra cost). Dinner and overnight stay at resort.
After breakfast, check out from the resort and drive back to Delhi. En route, stop for refreshments. Reach Delhi by evening. Tour concludes with fond memories of the hills and wildlife.

Start your journey from Delhi in the morning and drive towards Mussoorie, the 'Queen of Hills'. On arrival, check into your hotel and freshen up. In the evening, stroll along Mall Road, explore Camel's Back Road, and enjoy a ropeway ride to Gun Hill for breathtaking views of the Himalayan peaks. Overnight stay at Mussoorie.

After breakfast, embark on a full-day sightseeing tour. Visit Kempty Falls, Company Garden, and the Tibetan Buddhist Temple. Later, proceed to Lal Tibba – the highest point in Mussoorie, offering panoramic views of the snow-clad mountains. Evening at leisure for shopping on Mall Road or trying local cafes. Overnight stay at Mussoorie.

After breakfast, check out from the hotel. If time permits, visit Mussoorie Lake or Jharipani Falls for a short stopover. Later, begin your drive back to Delhi with unforgettable memories of your hill retreat. Tour ends on arrival.

Early morning departure from Delhi and proceed towards Mussoorie, popularly known as the 'Queen of Hills'. On arrival, check into the hotel. Later, explore Mall Road, Camel's Back Road, and Gun Hill (via ropeway) for panoramic views of the Himalayas. Evening free for leisure and shopping. Overnight stay at Mussoorie.

After breakfast, proceed for local sightseeing including Kempty Falls, Company Garden, and Lal Tibba (the highest point of Mussoorie). Enjoy scenic views and photography. Afternoon, check out and start drive back to Delhi with fond memories. Tour ends on arrival.

Start your journey from Delhi in the morning and drive towards Mussoorie, the 'Queen of Hills'. On arrival, check into your hotel and freshen up. In the evening, stroll along Mall Road, explore Camel's Back Road, and enjoy a ropeway ride to Gun Hill for breathtaking views of the Himalayan peaks. Overnight stay at Mussoorie.

After breakfast, embark on a full-day sightseeing tour. Visit Kempty Falls, Company Garden, and the Tibetan Buddhist Temple. Later, proceed to Lal Tibba – the highest point in Mussoorie, offering panoramic views of the snow-clad mountains. Evening at leisure for shopping on Mall Road or trying local cafes. Overnight stay at Mussoorie.

After breakfast, check out from the hotel. If time permits, visit Mussoorie Lake or Jharipani Falls for a short stopover. Later, begin your drive back to Delhi with unforgettable memories of your hill retreat. Tour ends on arrival.
Arrive at Goa airport/railway station and transfer to hotel. Check-in and relax at Calangute Beach. In the evening, enjoy the vibrant nightlife at Tito's Lane or beach shacks. Overnight stay in Goa.

After breakfast, proceed for a full-day North Goa sightseeing. Visit Fort Aguada, Anjuna Beach, Vagator Beach, and Baga Beach. Enjoy water sports (optional) or relax by the beach. Evening free for shopping or nightlife. Overnight stay in Goa.
Post breakfast, check out and explore South Goa. Visit Basilica of Bom Jesus, Miramar Beach, and Dona Paula viewpoint. Later, transfer to airport/railway station for departure. Tour ends.

Arrive in Goa, transfer to hotel and check-in. Later, head out for North Goa sightseeing – Fort Aguada, Candolim Beach, and Baga Beach. Evening free to enjoy nightlife or beachside cafes. Overnight stay in Goa.
After breakfast, check out and visit Basilica of Bom Jesus, Miramar Beach, and Dona Paula viewpoint. Later, proceed to the airport/railway station for your return journey. Tour ends.
On arrival, check-in at a houseboat/hotel. Enjoy Shikara ride on Dal Lake and explore Mughal Gardens – Shalimar Bagh, Nishat Bagh.
Drive to Gulmarg (approx. 2 hrs). Enjoy Gondola ride (optional), meadows, and snow activities. Return to Srinagar by evening.
After breakfast, visit Shankaracharya Temple and local Srinagar markets. Drop at airport. Tour ends.
Check-in at hotel/houseboat. Enjoy Dal Lake Shikara ride and visit Nishat & Shalimar Gardens.
After breakfast, visit Shankaracharya Temple and shop for Kashmiri handicrafts. Drop at airport. Tour ends.
On arrival, check-in at hotel/houseboat. Evening Shikara ride on Dal Lake and leisure.
After breakfast, drive to Gulmarg (2 hrs). Explore meadows, Gondola ride (optional), and snow activities. Return to Srinagar for overnight stay.
Full-day excursion to Pahalgam (3 hrs). Visit Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, and enjoy the Lidder River views. Return to Srinagar by evening.
After breakfast, visit Mughal Gardens and Shankaracharya Temple. Drop at airport. Tour ends.

packages.name: Shirdi - Ajanta - Ellora Trip With Daulatabad Fort

itinerary.details:
🚗 Journey

• Start early morning from Pune and drive to Shirdi.

• Shirdi is one of Maharashtra's most famous pilgrimage destinations and the home of Shri Sai Baba.

🛕 Shri Sai Baba Temple

• Visit the sacred Shri Sai Baba Temple.
• Take Darshan and seek blessings.
• Thousands of devotees from across the world visit this holy shrine every day.

🏡 Sai Heritage Village

• Explore Sai Heritage Village.
• Experience beautifully recreated scenes from Sai Baba's life.
• Enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

🎡 Sai Teerth Devotional Theme Park

• Visit India's first devotional theme park.
• Enjoy interactive shows based on Sai Baba's life.

🏨 Overnight Stay

• Overnight stay at Shirdi.

itinerary.day: Day 02 : Shirdi → Ajanta Caves → Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar (195 km | 4–5 hrs)
itinerary.details:
🍽️ Morning

• After breakfast, drive to Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar.

🏙️ About the City

• Formerly known as Aurangabad.
• Famous for UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
• Known for Bibi Ka Maqbara, Himroo fabrics, 52 historic gates and rich Mughal history.

🪨 Ajanta Caves

• Visit the UNESCO World Heritage Site.
• Explore ancient Buddhist caves dating back to the 2nd century BC.
• Admire beautiful murals, sculptures and monasteries.
• Walk through the caves overlooking the Waghora River.

✨ Highlights

• Chaityagrihas (Prayer Halls).
• Viharas (Monasteries).
• Ancient Buddhist paintings.

🏨 Overnight Stay

• Check-in to hotel.
• Overnight stay at Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar.

itinerary.day: Day 03 : Ellora Caves & Shri Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga
itinerary.details:
🍽️ Morning

• Breakfast at the hotel.
• Proceed for local sightseeing.

🪨 Ellora Caves

• Visit the UNESCO World Heritage Site.
• Explore 34 magnificent rock-cut caves.
• Discover Buddhist, Hindu and Jain monuments.
• Witness one of India's finest examples of ancient rock-cut architecture.

🛕 Shri Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga

• Visit one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas.
• Dedicated to Lord Shiva.
• Admire the beautifully carved temple architecture.
• Seek blessings at this revered shrine.

✨ Highlights

• Intricate stone carvings.
• Ancient temple pillars.
• Historic sculptures.

🏨 Overnight Stay

• Return to hotel.
• Overnight stay.

🍽️ Morning

• Breakfast and hotel check-out.

🏰 Daulatabad Fort

• Visit the historic Daulatabad Fort.
• Explore one of India's strongest hill forts.
• Walk through secret passages and massive fortification walls.
• Experience the famous 'Black Hole' labyrinth.
• Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views from the fort.

📸 Highlights

• Ancient military architecture.
• Scenic viewpoints.
• Historic defence system.

🚗 Return Journey

• Drive back to Pune.

🎉 Tour Ends

• Return with unforgettable memories.

itinerary.day: Day 01 : Pune → Ajanta Caves → Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar (Approx. 350 km | 5–6 hrs)
itinerary.details:
🚗 Journey

• Start early morning from Pune.
• Drive to Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar (formerly Aurangabad).

🏙️ About Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar

• Known as the City of Gates.
• Famous for Ajanta & Ellora Caves (UNESCO World Heritage Sites).
• Visit the historic city known for Himroo fabrics, Bibi Ka Maqbara and rich Mughal heritage.

🪨 Ajanta Caves

• Explore the world-famous Ajanta Caves.
• Buddhist caves dating back to the 2nd & 1st century BC.
• Admire ancient paintings, sculptures and beautifully carved monasteries.
• Walk through the caves overlooking the scenic Waghora River.

✨ Highlights

• UNESCO World Heritage Site.
• Ancient Buddhist Art.
• Rock-cut Chaityas & Viharas.

🏨 Overnight Stay

• Check-in at the hotel.
• Overnight stay at Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar.

itinerary.day: Day 02 : Ellora Caves & Shri Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga
itinerary.details:
🍽️ Morning

• Breakfast at the hotel.
• Proceed for full-day sightseeing.

🪨 Ellora Caves

• Visit the UNESCO World Heritage Site.
• Explore 34 magnificent rock-cut caves.
• Discover Buddhist, Hindu and Jain monuments built into basalt cliffs.
• Witness one of India's finest examples of ancient rock-cut architecture.

🛕 Shri Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga

• Visit one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva.
• Admire the beautiful stone carvings and temple architecture.
• Seek blessings at this revered pilgrimage site.

✨ Highlights

• UNESCO World Heritage Site.
• Kailasa Temple.
• Ancient sculptures and carvings.
• Sacred Jyotirlinga Darshan.

🏨 Overnight Stay

• Return to the hotel.
• Overnight stay at Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar.

itinerary.day: Day 03 : Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar → Daulatabad Fort → Pune
itinerary.details:
🍽️ Morning

• Breakfast at the hotel.
• Check-out and begin sightseeing.

🏰 Daulatabad Fort

• Visit the magnificent Daulatabad Fort.
• Explore one of India's strongest hill forts.
• Walk through massive fortification walls, secret passages and the famous 'Black Hole' labyrinth.
• Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views from the fort.

📸 Highlights

• Ancient military architecture.
• Historic defence system.
• Scenic viewpoints.

🚗 Return Journey

• Begin the drive back to Pune.

🎉 Tour Ends

• Return with wonderful memories of Maharashtra's rich heritage.

🚗 Journey

• Early morning departure from Pune to Nashik.
• Arrive and begin the spiritual tour of Nashik.

📍 Panchavati

• Visit one of the holiest places associated with Lord Rama.
• Explore the sacred ghats and temples.

📍 Ramkund

• Holy bathing tank where Lord Rama is believed to have performed rituals for his father.

📍 Kalaram Temple

• Visit the famous temple dedicated to Lord Rama.
• Admire the magnificent black stone idol.

📍 Sita Gufa & Kapileshwar Temple

• Explore the sacred cave associated with Goddess Sita.
• Visit the nearby Kapileshwar Temple.

📍 Muktidham Temple

• Built entirely with white marble.
• Houses replicas of all 12 Jyotirlingas.

🏨 Overnight Stay

• Check-in to hotel.
• Overnight stay at Nashik.

🍽️ Morning

• Breakfast at the hotel.
• Drive towards Trimbakeshwar.

🛕 Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga

• Visit one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas.
• Located at the foothills of Brahmagiri Mountain.
• Seek blessings at this revered Shiva temple.

🌊 Kushavarta Kund

• Visit the sacred pond believed to be the origin of River Godavari.
• A holy place where pilgrims take a ritual bath.

🪨 Pandavleni (Trirashmi) Caves

• Explore the ancient Buddhist rock-cut caves.
• Admire sculptures and carvings dating back to the 1st Century BCE.

🏨 Overnight Stay

• Return to Nashik.
• Overnight stay at the hotel.

🍽️ Morning

• Breakfast and hotel check-out.

🛕 Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga

• Drive through the scenic Sahyadri Hills.
• Visit one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva.
• Enjoy the peaceful surroundings and seek blessings.

✨ Highlights

• Scenic mountain drive.
• Spiritual Darshan.
• Beautiful forest landscape.

🚗 Return Journey

• Drive back to Pune.

🎉 Tour Ends

• Return with wonderful spiritual memories.

🚗 Journey Begins

• Start early morning from Pune.
• Begin the sacred Ashtavinayak Yatra.

🛕 Morgaon – Mayureshwar Ganpati

• Visit the first and most important temple of the Ashtavinayak circuit.
• Learn about Lord Ganesha defeating the demon Sindurasura.
• Take Darshan and seek blessings.

🛕 Siddhatek – Siddhivinayak Temple

• Visit the temple where Lord Vishnu attained Siddhi through penance.
• One of the most sacred Ganesh temples in Maharashtra.

🛕 Theur – Chintamani Ganpati

• Visit the famous Chintamani Temple.
• Explore its rich history connected with the Maratha Empire.

🏨 Overnight Stay

• Overnight stay at Pune or nearby area.

🍽️ Morning

• Breakfast and continue the pilgrimage.

🛕 Ranjangaon – Mahaganapati

• Visit the temple where Lord Shiva worshipped Lord Ganesha before defeating Tripurasura.

🛕 Ozar – Vighneshwar Ganapati

• Famous for its golden dome and beautiful Peshwa-style architecture.
• Associated with the legend of Ganesha defeating Vighnasura.

🛕 Lenyadri – Girijatmaj Ganpati

• Visit the only Ashtavinayak temple located inside a Buddhist cave.
• Lord Ganesha is worshipped here in his child form.

✨ Highlights

• Ancient cave temple.
• Scenic hill views.
• Spiritual experience.

🏨 Overnight Stay

• Overnight stay near Junnar/Pune.

🍽️ Morning

• Breakfast and check-out.

🛕 Mahad – Varadvinayak Temple

• Visit the temple believed to fulfill devotees' wishes.
• Seek blessings of Lord Ganesha.

🛕 Pali – Ballaleshwar Temple

• Visit the only Ashtavinayak temple named after a devotee.
• Learn about the inspiring story of devotee Ballal.

✨ Completion of Yatra

• Complete the sacred Ashtavinayak pilgrimage.
• Offer final prayers before departure.

🚗 Return Journey

• Drive back to Pune.

🎉 Tour Ends

• Return with divine blessings and unforgettable memories.
